old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a metallic pitcher placed on aluminum foil. Inside the pitcher, a spoon is resting, not moving, in a mixture that appears to be a combination of oil and a white substance, possibly butter or cream. The lighting highlights the reflective surface of the pitcher and the shiny texture of the aluminum foil beneath it. The background includes a glimpse of a wooden cutting board and some kitchen items, suggesting a cooking environment. The scene remains static throughout the frames, maintaining a steady focus on the pitcher and its contents.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a metallic pot placed on a stovetop, surrounded by aluminum foil. Inside the pot, a spoon is being used to stir a mixture that appears to be a combination of oil and a white substance, possibly butter or cream. The spoon moves methodically, creating ripples and bubbles in the liquid as it stirs. The lighting highlights the reflective surface of the pot and the shiny texture of the aluminum foil beneath it. The background includes a glimpse of a wooden cutting board and some kitchen items, suggesting a cooking environment. The stirring continues consistently throughout the frames, indicating a process of heating or melting the ingredients. There are no significant changes in the scene, maintaining a steady focus on the pot and its contents.
caption: The video captures a stainless steel pot resting on crumpled aluminum foil, its interior holding a shallow pool of pale yellowish liquid. A soft, opaque white mass sits in the liquid, accompanied by a smaller white patch to the left. A metal spoon rests with its bowl near the lower side, and a thin dark rod leans diagonally against the rim. Throughout the clip the white mass slowly changes shape, its irregular edges becoming smoother and more rounded as it appears to melt or dissolve into the surrounding fluid. The smaller patch likewise deforms and reduces slightly, with tiny surface bubbles appearing and shifting across it. The spoon and the dark rod remain essentially stationary, showing no stirring or contact. The overall liquid level and the foil background stay unchanged, and the camera view holds fixed on this ongoing, gradual transformation.
